events.title: Open Weights Reach the Frontier
events.description: An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

events.title: Frontier Access Denied
events.description: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user. No detailed reason is given, there is no appeal, and the immediate practical effect lands on hospitals, ministries and firms that had built on it. Whether this reads at home as an outrage or as a failure of foresight depends on what the Union had done about it beforehand.

events.title: Coercion Over ASML
events.description: Washington forces the Netherlands to cut ASML's exports and servicing further still – beyond the leading-edge machines to the older lithography equipment China uses for ordinary chips, and in the harder versions to a widening list of other customers. The instrument is jurisdiction over American technology in the supply chain, and refusing it is not obviously survivable for the company. The Union's one chokepoint is being used, and not by the Union.

portfolio.name: Establish EU Public Trust Corps for AI Incident Response and Transparency
portfolio.description: Create a civilian technical corps under the European Commission, staffed with red-team engineers, crisis communicators, and regional liaison officers, to lead public-facing incident response, conduct live transparency drills, and operate a 24/7 AI incident dashboard with verified threat status, system outages, and mitigation progress.` — **finishes this turn**

portfolio.name: Launch EU AI Accountability Tribunal and Remediation Fund
portfolio.description: Establish a supranational legal body with investigative authority over AI-driven harms in public and hybrid systems, empowered to compel evidence, issue public findings, and order compensation. Back it with a €10bn fund for rapid redress, seeded from fines on non-compliant deployments.

portfolio.name: Emergency Sovereign Compute Mobilisation
portfolio.description: Accelerate the deployment of EU-controlled, high-performance AI compute clusters on sovereign soil, repurposing stalled Gigafactory sites and commandeering priority grid access, to restore immediate operational access to frontier-level systems.

portfolio.name: Deploy EU Emergency Public AI Service for Cyber Incident Response
portfolio.description: Launch a fully sovereign, EU-operated AI system to detect, patch, and communicate about active cyber threats in real time, using repurposed compute from the Finnish Gigafactory cluster and open-weight models hardened against misuse, to deliver immediate public protection and visible proof of Union agency.
